hook: Your phone can show a light flickering.
title: Your Phone Shows Your Bulb Flickering
description:
Lights run on alternating current, and many bulbs flicker faster than your eyes can notice. Slow-motion video at 240 fps can reveal it, and a ceiling fan can look strange too. Results vary by bulb and phone, so try it yourself.

Series: Try This Now.

#Shorts #PhoneTricks #Tech
comment_prompt: Did your bulb flicker? Yes or no

scenes.narration: Your phone can show a light flickering.
scenes.headline: TRY THIS NOW

scenes.narration: Switch on a ceiling fan and a bulb.
scenes.headline: FAN AND BULB

scenes.narration: Open slow-motion mode at 240 frames per second.
scenes.headline: SLOW-MO 240 FPS

scenes.narration: You will see it pulse on screen.
scenes.headline: IT PULSES

scenes.narration: That is alternating current at work.
scenes.headline: AC POWER

scenes.narration: The blades can look slowed or frozen.
scenes.headline: BLADES FREEZE

scenes.narration: Your phone just showed light flickering.
scenes.headline: YOU SAW IT

scenes.headline: NEXT: A BROKEN ROAD
